title: The Snow on Only One Side of the Twig
youtube_title: The Snow on Only One Side of the Twig | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Brisa finds a snow loyal to one side of a twig. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Brisa shows Anouk how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
